body:
New PcNpcState wire type (measured: PcSnapshotPacket 1436->1604 bytes), server-side ServerNpc array spawning 3 citizens/1 the_men/4 zombies on a circle around origin, server_tick_npcs runs npc_brain_tick/zombie_tick every real server tick (the S504 S8b brains are now live, not just tested in isolation). Client's two hardcoded test NPCs replaced with a real loop over the live snapshot; role->kit/tint + yaw->facing_rad factored into bigo_npc_visual.h for headless testability (5 tests). Verified live: compiled server spawns all 8 NPCs and runs the full tick loop for 6s, no crash. NORTHSTAR.md S8d/S8e updated, README corrected per SAGA. Commits e102355/6364a41.

⚓ ☃
title: S504 §8c/8d: live NPC entity system — server spawns/ticks real Citizens/The Men/zombies, client renders them via the mannequin+animation library
